newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares inch higher as BTC soars.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares inch higher as BTC soars.

text.p: Slovenian shares closed 0.43 percent higher on Friday, fuelled by a nearly four percent gain in warehouse operator BTC, traders said.
* The SBI index rose 5.63 points to 1,315.10.
* Overall four shares rose and six fell, while two were flat and 15 were untraded.
* BTC was the top gainer, rising 3.77 percent to 13,490 tolars on volume of 73 shares, on speculation the company may issue global despository receipts (GDR). -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
